description: The WWF Risk Filter Suite is a set of three free online tools for companies and financial institutions to assess and act on nature-related risks: the WWF Water Risk Filter, the WWF Biodiversity Risk Filter and the new Place-based Impact Estimator (PIE). By aggregating more than 80 global scientific datasets and adjusting them for industry characteristics, the filters let users screen and prioritise risk hotspots across their operations, value chains and investment portfolios, before deeper local analysis. Coverage: global. The Biodiversity Risk Filter has inform, explore (risk maps, country profiles and methodology documentation) and assess modules covering physical, regulatory and reputational risks; the Water Risk Filter has its own assess module; PIE identifies places where investment in nature can meet several environmental and social goals, with its own data and methods pages and impact potential datasets. Format and access: web applications with maps and data and methods documentation; free, with a registration link on the home page. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): WWF Risk Filter Suite terms of use: free of charge with an account; content protected, copying for other uses prohibited. Caveats: the tools are corporate screening tools at a coarse scale, not site hazard models; how the underlying datasets can be downloaded was not read. Simulation uses: screening water stress, flood and ecosystem risk at the locations of plants, supply chain sites and infrastructure assets. Related records: the WRI Aqueduct water risk atlas (data-wri-aqueduct-water-risk-atlas) provides comparable global water risk indicators.
